_comment: One job per STRIP — the whole strip as one image, for the concept run. Run with comic_render.py --provider runway|google|openai.

jobs.title: THE SCUMM STICK · GIVE coffee TO bird
jobs.prompt: a single full-page comic drawing (1 panels). Style: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition. Cast, the same faces, hair and builds in every panel, ages exactly as given: THE BIRD — a small plump songbird, teal head, rose-pink breast, green wing, long teal tail, every color, wrong for the coast. Clothes, hair-dos and anything held come from this strip's description, never from the reference sheet; hands are empty unless a panel names what they hold. Title of the strip: BACKUP. The strip: The seawall as a room, the bird on the wall outlined, the crow at the far end outlined, GIVE coffee TO bird, and the engine's answer as a blank balloon again. The inventory loses the coffee anyway. The page draws a thing given to something that doesn't take things. Panel 1: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a page laid out like an old point-and-click adventure screen with a scene in the upper two-thirds, a row of verbs in a monospaced hand beneath it with one marked, and a strip of small drawn inventory objects along the bottom, a seawall with a small rainbow bird outlined as a hotspot and a crow at the far end, a coffee cup set on the wall beside the bird, a small empty speech balloon beneath the verb row, no words legible (in this panel: THE BIRD). No text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature; leave clean space in each panel where balloons would go. Reference @the_bird is the model sheet for THE BIRD: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @wood_2026 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @loc_main_street shows the setting; keep its architecture and props. Match the attached references: @the_bird for the character the bird; @wood_2026 for the concept design; @loc_main_street for the setting.
